bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
names="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}')"
pg="$(printf '%s\n' "$names" | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
gay="$(printf '%s\n' "$names" | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_PG_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 65; }
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$gay" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_BOT_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 66; }
echo STK04_POSTGRES_DATABASES
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -At -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datallowconn AND NOT datistemplate ORDER BY datname"' | head -n 25
echo STK04_NETWORK_CHECK
docker exec "$gay" node -e 'const dns=require("dns"),https=require("https");console.log("STK04_PROXY_ENV_KEYS="+Object.keys(process.env).filter(x=>/proxy/i.test(x)).join(","));dns.lookup("api.telegram.org",(e,a)=>{console.log("STK04_DNS="+(e?e.code:"PASS"));const req=https.get("https://api.telegram.org/",{timeout:8000},r=>{console.log("STK04_HTTPS_STATUS="+r.statusCode);r.resume()});req.on("timeout",()=>req.destroy(new Error("TIMEOUT")));req.on("error",x=>console.log("STK04_HTTPS_ERROR="+x.code))})'
echo STK04_DB_NET_CHECK_FINISHED
